owns.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860M (Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory)
owns.basis: net summer capacity (capacity_mw) by the plant's balancing authority

coming.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-860M (Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory)

burns.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-930, the six-month BALANCE files (net generation by source; EIA's adjusted values where it prints them)

co2.why: EIA's hourly CO2 estimates held by the ERW (eia930_all_emissions, from EIA's Grid Monitor workbooks) cover the seven ISOs and the Lower 48 only

trades.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-930, each side's report of the flow; the mean of the two reports
trades.why: the share is given for an authority (ba_trade_partners); a region's net imports are in trade/<region>.json

size.source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Form EIA-930, demand (adjusted where EIA prints it; screened as the demand file's method says)

large_loads.source: the public documents each row names (filings, statements, presentations)
large_loads.how: a row whose grid is one of the seven is placed in that grid's authority; a utility group's rows in the authority EIA names for it (the builder's GROUP_BA); groups spanning several authorities are not placed (NOT_PLACED)
